main_objective: Improve faithful human-sounding prose and learn conditional relations between realization and Pangram behavior; do not optimize detector labels by losing meaning.
next_target_set: New distinct passage families not represented by these source paragraphs, owner rewrites, neighboring same-section variants or already-discussed outcomes; split by source family and keep section/article grouping visible.

arms.A: Same fixed concise source/meaning brief and current revision instructions; no target-matched teaching episodes.
arms.B: Same brief, model/reasoning/token budget and permitted changes, plus up to three literal owner-endorsed or clearly marked provisional teaching episodes matched by rhetorical function. Exclude target family, its rewrites and detector outcomes.

important_distinction: This tests whether example retrieval improves the complete writing method. It does not isolate one textual feature. A later feature study requires a different predeclared multi-family intervention.
generation: One first candidate per arm per target, genuinely separate fresh contexts. No same-context pretending to forget a target. Counterbalance arm order and preserve exact prompts/output/model settings. No adaptive retries in the primary comparison.
source_constraints: Retain substantive claims, certainty, attribution, actors, causality and action-changing qualifications.
Retain meaningful humor, contrast, analogy and legitimate abstraction.
Do not require preserving every scaffolding sentence verbatim; document genuine implication preservation instead of automatically treating every deletion as a lost fact.
primary_evidence: Source-alignment assessment, with pass/change/uncertain and exact explanation.
Owner naturalness preference on a small balanced calibration subset, with roles and blind/nonblind status explicit.
Fresh reviewer estimates on remaining cases labeled as reviewer estimates, not owner preferences.
detector_evidence: Exact input boundary and version for every observed result.
Standalone and selected genuine 2–3-paragraph contexts are separate outcomes.
Count all-Human gains, regressions and no-flips across families; report altered-span windows separately where exact mapping is possible.
Keep GUI avg_ai_likelihood and API fraction_ai under their original field names; do not pool them as calibrated probabilities.
A no-flip does not prove no editorial or detector benefit. A numerical change alone does not prove a causal benefit.
fidelity_accounting: Retain every generated candidate in the denominator. Report meaning/rhetorical damage separately and disqualify it from joint-quality success; do not silently filter failures after seeing outcomes.
statistics: First report paired descriptive differences and family-clustered uncertainty. Do not count multiple revisions of one target as independent. Do not pool the current outcome-adapted production archive into a prospective causal effect estimate.
interaction_followup: Only after a plausible conditional pattern recurs across several target families, predeclare a small matched interaction comparison. Single-paragraph flips may motivate it but cannot validate portability.
admission_before_paid_calls: Pin exact target set, source functions and split.
Complete distinct-context route verification without using already-known target outcomes.
Freeze prompts, candidate outputs and predictions.
Check prior exact-input cache and keep an auditable call journal.
execution_boundary: No paid or independent-evaluator execution in this packet. Earlier blocked live API/evaluator actions were not retried or rerouted.
api_size_limit: 1–3 paragraphs per submission; whole-article checks remain the owner manual Substack route.
next_safe_action: Recover additional clean, function-diverse owner-aligned episodes or source paragraphs using the pinned paths in the curation; then construct the distinct-family target manifest. Do not launch a claimed 30-family trial from 30 dependent/meaning-changing comparisons.
